formId.title: Form Id
formId.description: Id of the form to change

field.title: Field
field.description: The field to change, by its label as shown in the outline, for example Which session?

newLabel.title: New Label
newLabel.description: New label for the field. Leave empty to keep it.

helpText.title: Help Text
helpText.description: New help text under the field. Leave empty to keep it.

placeholder.title: Placeholder
placeholder.description: New placeholder inside the input. Leave empty to keep it.

required.title: Required
required.description: yes to make the field required, no to make it optional. Leave empty to keep it.

addOptions.title: Add Options
addOptions.description: Choices to add to a dropdown, single choice or checkboxes field, or columns to a table, separated by commas, or one per line when a choice contains a comma, for example Evening. Existing choices are kept.

removeOptions.title: Remove Options
removeOptions.description: Choices to remove, separated by commas, or one per line when a choice contains a comma.

replaceOptions.title: Replace Options
replaceOptions.description: The complete new list of choices, separated by commas, or one per line when a choice contains a comma. Replaces all existing choices.

afterField.title: Move After Field
afterField.description: Move the field directly after this other field (its label).

pageName.title: Move To Page
pageName.description: Move the field to the end of this page (title or number).

remove.title: Remove Field
remove.description: True to delete the field from the form. Rules that used it are dropped.
